name: Evaluation {OS}
tagline: Measure AI output quality with rubrics, not vibes.

commands.name: /eval rubric <task>
commands.summary: Turn examples of good and bad output into criteria with observable anchors.

commands.name: /eval set <task>
commands.summary: Build the fixed versioned evaluation set, adversarial and refusal cases included.

commands.name: /eval run <version>
commands.summary: Score a version per case per criterion, each score with its reason.

commands.name: /eval calibrate
commands.summary: Measure how well an automated grader agrees with human labels, per criterion.

commands.name: /eval compare <a> <b>
commands.summary: Compare two versions with the uncertainty stated alongside the difference.

commands.name: /eval regress [baseline]
commands.summary: Detect regressions against the accepted baseline and name the failing cases.

commands.name: /eval report
commands.summary: Report the trend, checked against outcomes, with no release recommendation.

requires_human_approval_for: changing the evaluation set, which invalidates historical comparisons
retiring a criterion, especially one the system currently scores badly on
publishing a score as a claim outside the team
using an automated grader in place of human labels where measured agreement is low
